- 外国人怎么拿意大利税号｜意大利外交部官网（2026-10-19 查阅）：「I cittadini stranieri possono richiedere il codice fiscale」途径为经居住地所属意大利领事机构提交（附身份证件复印件和申请理由）、以特别授权书委托他人向意大利税务局（Agenzia delle Entrate）办公室提交、或入境后直接去税务局办公室办理；迈阿密总领馆页写只有在需要在线办理等无法委托他人的情况下才可向领事机构申请 https://www.esteri.it/it/servizi-opportunita/italiani-all-estero/codice_fiscale/ https://consmiami.esteri.it/it/servizi-consolari-e-visti/servizi-per-il-cittadino-italiano/codice-fiscale/cittadini-stranieri-non-residenti-in-italia/
- Altery 有 FPS / SEPA instant / ACH｜Altery 官网与帮助中心（2026-10-19 查阅）：帮助中心写可用 Faster Payment 收发 GBP、SEPA 用于 SEPA 区内 EUR 转账「credited within one working day」；个人账户费用表 ACH transfer in USD 为 1%、min $1，注明「Currently only available to UK residents」，Rest of the World 列为 Currently unavailable https://help.altery.com/hc/en-us/articles/12591455166493-What-s-the-Faster-Payment-system https://help.altery.com/hc/en-us/articles/12633971819677-What-are-SEPA-payments https://altery.com/fees/
